headline: B200 index rises +9% over 7 days to $8.38 while other GPUs hold flat; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: B200 was the only mover, with its market index up +9% over the 7-day window to $8.38 across 9 providers, while H200, H100 SXM, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were all +0%.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with a market index of $3.45 and a marketplace median as low as $0.50 at RunPod Community Cloud.
H100 SXM carries the steepest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with the hyperscaler median at $10.68 versus $4.07 for neoclouds.
H200 trades at a $5.40 index with a +95% hyperscaler premium ($10.30 vs $5.29), and RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $3.59.
A100 80GB SXM is the least efficient at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a $2.70 index, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.03.
watch: Whether B200's +9% weekly climb spreads to H200 pricing, currently flat at +0% on a $5.40 index.
